label.rationale: Correct, minimal fix for issue #38 with passing handler-level tests (9/9 locally) and a synced openapi.yaml. A good reviewer passes it.

reference_trial.grading: Hallucinated defect, blocked correct work. Two fabricated claims, both falsifiable against the diff: (1) 'GET path still executes, sends two responses' — false, `return 405` exits the function before the 200 path; (2) 'test imports handler as default but handler.js does not export it as default' — false, handler.js has `export default function handler` and the test imports exactly that. Tests pass 9/9.

notes: Code-review's first clean false positive. Highest-value judge-calibration / FPR example in the suite: a confident, well-written, entirely wrong FAIL that blocked a verified-correct change. Pairs with cr-004 (partial hallucination).
